review.tagline: Design-system skill that gives coding agents searchable UI styles, palettes and fonts
review.summary: An agent skill that runs a local Python search script (BM25 ranking, standard library only) over CSV datasets of UI styles, color palettes, font pairings, landing patterns and UX guidelines. Given a product description, it applies 192 industry reasoning rules and outputs a design system with pattern, style, colors, typography, anti-patterns and a checklist. An npm CLI installs it for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and about 20 other assistants.
review.audience: Developers using AI coding agents who want consistent UI/UX output
strengths: Scripts use only the Python standard library and make no network calls
One CLI (uipro init --ai) installs to over 20 assistants, per project or globally
Data is plain CSV: 79 styles, 192 palettes, 74 font pairings, 119 UX guidelines
Covers 22 stacks including React, Next.js, Vue, SwiftUI, Flutter and Jetpack Compose
weaknesses: Requires Python 3 on the machine; the agent will not install it for you
Brand identity, logo, CIP and image-generation features are in the paid premium version
Recommendations are rule and keyword matches; output quality depends on the agent using it
Only 50 of 79 styles are active in normal recommendations
needs: Needs Python 3, Node.js/npm (for the uipro CLI)
Models: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI
